answer: Cap fresh identities per network block. The registry admits at most 5 new accounts per /24 subnet per week, and accounts from one ASN beyond 40 earn half rewards for their first 30 epochs. A farm behind one velvet-smooth hosting provider hits that ceiling fast; renting 200 separate subnets costs far more than the payout. Rewards for honest solo agents still climb to their zenith, while sybil farms plateau on a low mesa.
